title_en: Psychology Made Simple (2/20): The Memory Warehouse in Your Head
note_en: In 老师把记忆分成几种 "the teacher divided memory into several types," 把 pulls the object 记忆 in front of the verb, and the verb carries a result: 分成 "divide into." English just says verb + object, but Chinese likes 把 when something is done to a definite object with a clear outcome, as in 把一个很长的电话号码分成几组 "break a long phone number into groups."
